name: clickflash-ecosystem
description: ClickFlash Photography Ecosystem - 6 apps for professional photographers

scripts.dev:legacy: concurrently "pnpm run dev:master" "pnpm run dev:touch" "pnpm run dev:management" "pnpm run dev:gallery" "pnpm run dev:website" "pnpm run dev:mcp" --names "master,touch,management,gallery,website,mcp" --prefix-colors "blue,green,purple,pink,cyan,yellow"
scripts.install:apps: pnpm --filter clickflash-master install && pnpm --filter clickflash-touch install && pnpm --filter star-master-management install && pnpm --filter star-master-customer install && pnpm --filter main-website install && pnpm --filter moneytrash-uploader install && pnpm --filter clickflash-installer install && pnpm --filter clickflash-license-generator install
scripts.build:master: pnpm --filter clickflash-master run build && pnpm --filter clickflash-master run build:backend
scripts.build:touch: pnpm --filter clickflash-touch run build && pnpm --filter clickflash-touch run build:backend
scripts.test:ecosystem: pnpm --filter clickflash-master test && pnpm --filter star-master-management test && pnpm --filter star-master-customer test && pnpm --filter clickflash-touch test
scripts.test:ecosystem:coverage: pnpm --filter clickflash-master run test:coverage && pnpm --filter star-master-management run test:coverage && pnpm --filter star-master-customer run test:coverage && pnpm --filter clickflash-touch run test:coverage
scripts.test:ecosystem:ci: pnpm --filter clickflash-master run test:ci && pnpm --filter star-master-management run test:ci && pnpm --filter star-master-customer run test:ci && pnpm --filter clickflash-touch run test:ci
scripts.test:e2e: npx tsx tests/ecosystem/reset.ts && npx playwright test --config=playwright.ecosystem.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:web: pnpm --filter main-website run test:e2e && pnpm --filter star-master-customer run test:e2e && pnpm --filter star-master-management run test:e2e && pnpm --filter moneytrash-uploader run test:e2e
scripts.test:prod: npx tsx tests/ecosystem/reset.ts && npx playwright test --config=playwright.prod.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:full: bash scripts/boot-emulator.sh && concurrently "pnpm run test:e2e" "pnpm run test:mobile" --success first --kill-others
scripts.lint:all: pnpm --filter clickflash-master run lint && pnpm --filter clickflash-touch run lint && pnpm --filter star-master-management run lint && pnpm --filter star-master-customer run lint && pnpm --filter main-website run lint && pnpm --filter moneytrash-uploader run lint && pnpm --filter clickflash-installer run lint && pnpm --filter clickflash-license-generator run lint && pnpm --filter mobile run lint
scripts.typecheck:all: pnpm --filter clickflash-master run typecheck:ci && pnpm --filter clickflash-touch run typecheck && pnpm --filter star-master-management run typecheck && pnpm --filter star-master-customer run typecheck && pnpm --filter main-website run typecheck && pnpm --filter moneytrash-uploader run typecheck && pnpm --filter clickflash-installer run typecheck && pnpm --filter clickflash-license-generator run typecheck && pnpm --filter mobile run typecheck
scripts.clean:all: pnpm --filter clickflash-master run clean 2>/dev/null; pnpm --filter clickflash-touch run clean 2>/dev/null; rm -rf apps/*/dist apps/*/.next apps/*/node_modules/.cache
